record: Sprint 07 plugin build record (Linux dev container)

native_core_record.fma_contraction_policy: OFF: -ffp-contract=off (GCC default for GNU C++ is 'fast'); products and sums are rounded separately so FIR accumulation reproduces the numpy pairwise order
native_core_record.denormal_policy: none (no FTZ/DAZ; bit-identity with the reference; all filters are feed-forward so denormals cannot self-sustain)

juce_pin.dependency_method: approved local checkout at third_party/JUCE (git-ignored; depth-1 clone of the tag); plugin/CMakeLists.txt verifies the checkout commit against this pin before configuring
juce_pin.license_route_selected: GNU AGPLv3 (JUCE dual-licence open-source option) for this unpublished personal-use build; the JUCE 8 End User Licence Agreement was NOT accepted on the owner's behalf; JUCE_DISPLAY_SPLASH_SCREEN=0 and JUCE_REPORT_APP_USAGE=0 as permitted under the AGPLv3 option

bundled_sdks.VST3 SDK (Steinberg, bundled in modules/: used under its GPLv3 option (consistent with the AGPLv3 route); the proprietary Steinberg VST3 licence was not accepted

required_notices_if_distributed: AGPLv3 text and corresponding source for the combined work
VST is a trademark of Steinberg Media Technologies GmbH
juce_pin.owner_action_still_required: none for private personal use without distribution; if the owner intends to distribute or prefers the commercial/Personal JUCE EULA route (splash screen, revenue limits) or the proprietary Steinberg VST3 licence, the owner must accept those terms personally — not performed here, no purchase made

floating_point_policy: core: -O2 -ffp-contract=off -fno-fast-math -fexcess-precision=standard (PUBLIC on the core target, visible in the core object FLAGS above); PIC enabled for the shared module (no code change); no LTO (juce_recommended_lto_flags not used); JUCE recommended config flags add no fast-math; no FTZ/DAZ guard (juce::ScopedNoDenormals deliberately not used)
cxxflags_workaround: the CXXFLAGS environment adds only -D definitions (module options) so that JUCE's juceaide bootstrap compiles without Xrandr/Xinerama/Xcursor/ALSA headers; it contains no floating-point flags; not needed on Windows
formats_built: Standalone (plugin/build/SMLSP3000_artefacts/Release/Standalone/SML SP-3000, Linux, no audio backend)
